body:
Read-only pre-review of PR #3497. Findings:

**Test-only claim: holds.** The PR diff touches only `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_posed.rs`. No production code changes.

**`#[test]` count: does not go down.** 5 tests before, 8 after; three new pinning tests added.

**The tests pin what #3248 asks.**
- `one_of_two_work_turning_rotaries_off_the_wcs_origin_refuses_by_name` (first_traverse_posed.rs:292): binds the refusal to `Err` from `GenerateOperation::new`, then asserts four fragments — "work-turning rotary A", "pivot or offset", "off the WCS origin", "cannot be judged". All four match the production refusal text at `crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse_posed.rs:86` verbatim. If the two-rotary refusal regresses, the `Ok` arm panics with the status and verdicts; if the message loses its name, the fragment assert fails. The test fails on regression, not on incidental text.
- `a_zero_pivot_on_two_work_turning_rotaries_reads_the_sphere_as_before` (line 307): control, asserts `OpStatus::Ok` and no `FirstTraverseLow`.
- `a_vertical_work_turning_rotary_with_a_stated_pivot_is_not_refused` (line 316): exercises both a 40 mm and a zero pivot on the vertical C line; the drop-out is real in production (`first_traverse_posed.rs:101-106`: a vertical line never takes the off-origin refusal, then `Ok(None)`). Assertions bind to generation success and to the absence of the first-traverse verdict, not to incidental text.

**Helper refactor: did not weaken other tests.** `laid_bar_on` now returns `Err` for a refusal and `laid_bar_on_two_rotaries` keeps the panicking wrapper, so the existing happy-path test (`two_work_turning_rotaries_read_the_rotary_kinds_stock_on_its_sphere`) has the same failure behaviour as before. The `Err` path also covers a missing cached toolpath with the op status in the message, which is a stricter failure than the old `expect("cached path")` panic.

Notes (non-blocking):
- `one_of_two_work_turning_rotaries...` relies on `find` picking A first in the two-rotary branch (`first_traverse_posed.rs:92`); correct today, and the fragment assert would catch a change to B.
- The `Err` string from `GenerateOperation::new` is formatted with `{e:?}`; the fragment asserts do not depend on debug formatting of the error payload beyond the refusal text, so this is fine.

No blockers found.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 144036fcf90b18d3eda39191354c72b890851707 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One blocker: clippy with `-D warnings` fails on this test file.

## What looks good

- The change is test-only. It touches only `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_posed.rs`. No production code changes.
- The three new tests pin the two cases that #3248 names. The `#[test]` count goes from 5 to 8.
- The refusal test reads four parts of the refusal text. Each part agrees with `crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse_posed.rs:86`.
- The vertical case uses pivot `[0, 0, 40]`. `off_origin` is true for this pivot, so the test reaches the `rotary_line(a) != RotaryLine::Vertical` guard at `first_traverse_posed.rs:101`.
- `laid_bar_on` returns the refusal as `Err`, the same way `contour5d_on` does.
- The body ends with `Fixes #3248` and has a `Changelog: none` line. The commit subjects are conventional.

## Results (locally, trial merge of the PR head with upstream/main `6e641da`)

- Quick gate, `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: one step, `app suites: first_traverse_posed`, ok in 155 s. 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- Clippy, `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test first_traverse_posed -- -D warnings`: **FAIL**.

```
error: function `generate` is never used
   --> crates/app/tests/first_traverse_posed.rs:121:4
121 | fn generate(world: &World, h: &mut History, src: &str, p: OpParams) -> (OpStatus, Vec<Warning>) {
error: could not compile `camcraft-app` (test "first_traverse_posed") due to 1 previous error
```

- Extra suites run: none. The diff does not touch `testdata/`, fixtures, goldens or importer code.
- Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` maps the diff to `app heavy: first_traverse_posed`. The body says that the diff reaches no lane. The file has no `#[ignore]` test, so the lane runs 0 tests. Not run in this review. It is not a blocker, but correct the sentence in the body.

## Mutations (production code, local only, then restored)

1. Remove the two-rotary off-origin refusal (`first_traverse_posed.rs:92-94`): `one_of_two_work_turning_rotaries_off_the_wcs_origin_refuses_by_name` goes red (`no refusal: Ok []`). The other tests stay green.
2. Remove the vertical guard `&& rotary_line(a) != RotaryLine::Vertical` (`first_traverse_posed.rs:101`): `a_vertical_work_turning_rotary_with_a_stated_pivot_is_not_refused` goes red with the refusal for rotary C. The other tests stay green.

Each new test fails on the regression that it pins.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_posed.rs:121` - the helper `generate` has no caller now. Its one caller, `laid_bar_on_two_rotaries`, now goes through `laid_bar_on`. The batch tier runs `clippy -D warnings` on `camcraft-app --all-targets` (`xtask/src/plan.rs:25`, `:161-170`), so this makes the post-merge gate on main red. Remove `generate`. As an alternative, make `laid_bar_on` call it on the success path. Then run `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test first_traverse_posed -- -D warnings` and add the result to the body.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The body says that `cargo xtask gate heavy --dry-run` reaches no lane. On this head it reaches `app heavy: first_traverse_posed`, which has no ignored test. Correct the sentence.
- Points 2 and 3 of #3248 (a rotary-kind refusal at generation, and the refusal for each machine) are not in this PR. `Fixes #3248` closes the issue. Either change it to `Refs #3248`, or file a follow-up issue for points 2 and 3 and name it in the body.

Review fix pushed: the unused generate helper is removed; clippy -p camcraft-app --test first_traverse_posed -- -D warnings is clean and the suite passes 8/8. The heavy-lane sentence in the body is corrected (the lane maps to app heavy: first_traverse_posed and runs 0 tests).

## Mutations (production code, local only, then restored)

2. Remove the vertical guard `&& rotary_line(a) != RotaryLine::Vertical` (`first_traverse_posed.rs:101`): `a_vertical_work_turning_rotary_with_a_stated_pivot_is_not_refused` goes red with the refusal for rotary C. The other 7 tests stay green.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_posed.rs:126-127`: the fix commit leaves two blank lines in a row. `rustfmt` removes one. No gate checks the format.
